newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade fairly active $67-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade fairly active $67-USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 16,000 slaughter steers and 12,500 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date, 416,00 head confirmed, including 20,600 head or about 50 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00, pen 1200 lbs 67.50; pen Select with end Choice 1325 lb cutting bulls 66.00; few pens Select and Choice 1100-1300 lb Holsteins 60.00-61.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 107.00-109.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1150 lbs 67.00, pen Select with end Choice 1080 lbs 66.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 107.00-109.00, hot weights, delivered.
Confirmed - 28,500 last week - none last year - 4,900
Wk to date - 41,600 last week - 12,200 last year - 18,500
